title: Icthlarin's Little Helper

overview.startPoint: Talk to the wanderer, south-east of the southern bridge over the River Elid, in the desert far south of Al Kharid.

enemies.text: Apmeken, Het, Crondis, or Scabaras apparitions (levels 56-58)
enemies.name: Apmeken, Het, Crondis, or Scabaras apparitions

enemies.text: Mummies (level 70) and scarab swarms (level 12) are not required, but aggressive nonetheless.
enemies.name: Mummies
enemies.note: and scarab swarms (level 12) are not required, but aggressive nonetheless.

needed.html: Cat and 1,000 coins (if taking carpet)

blocks.html: Head to the north of Sophanem. You can use the magic carpet network south of Shantay Pass from Al Kharid to get to Nardah, and then run southwest.
blocks.text: Head to the north of Sophanem. You can use the magic carpet network south of Shantay Pass from Al Kharid to get to Nardah, and then run southwest.

blocks.html: Talk to the wanderer while your cat is following you.
blocks.text: Talk to the wanderer while your cat is following you.

options.text: Tell me about Sophanem. [Icthlarin's Little Helper]

substeps.html: The wanderer is located a short distance north of Sophanem, east of the river but west of the Agility Pyramid.
substeps.text: The wanderer is located a short distance north of Sophanem, east of the river but west of the Agility Pyramid.

blocks.html: Open the northern door on the southern pyramid (picture of a cat).
blocks.text: Open the northern door on the southern pyramid (picture of a cat).

blocks.caption: Demonstrating the path to avoid the pitfalls.

blocks.html: You will arrive inside a maze.
blocks.text: You will arrive inside a maze.

blocks.html: Run past the initial wall crushers and walk on the denser rubble (dotted lines indicate the locations of pitfall traps).
blocks.text: Run past the initial wall crushers and walk on the denser rubble (dotted lines indicate the locations of pitfall traps).

substeps.html: Alternatively follow the path shown in the image to the right.
substeps.text: Alternatively follow the path shown in the image to the right.

blocks.html: Avoid traps and aggressive monsters until you reach a pit.

substeps.html: [Optional] Run past the wall crushers to the east and open the chest to complete Icthlarin's Little Chest.

blocks.html: Kill the apparition that spawns. You can safe-spot it by using the table in the room (unless you have the canopic jar of Apmeken or Crondis).

blocks.html: Return the canopic jar by clicking the empty space with the lighting effect (the original location of your jar).
